**Summary of what's covered:**

- **Le 1947 à Cheval Blanc** ★★★ — Chef Yannick Alléno, ~€415pp, 5 tables, fermentation-sauce driven Savoie menu; Dec–Apr only
- **Le Sarkara** ★★ — Chef Sébastien Vauxion, plant-based pastry-led tasting menu (unique in France), K2 Palace; Dec–Apr only
- **Baumanière 1850** ★★ — Chef Thomas Prod'homme, Alpine-Provençal fusion, ~€195–220pp, three menu lengths; best value of the three
- **Sylvestre Wahid – Les Grandes Alpes** ★★ — **Permanently closed**: the hotel was destroyed by fire on 28 January 2026 (270 evacuated); chef has relocated to Provence

Notable context included: Le Chabichou dropped from 2★ to 1★ in the 2026 Michelin guide; Le Kintessence (Jean-Rémi Caillon) no longer active as standalone restaurant at K2 Palace.
